research_question: Does historical host-climate information persist once host and insect observational reference points are spatially independent, same-count, and measured against insect climate history, current host/self climate and geographic distance?
prior_results_exposed: Previously observed 90-species incomplete-host v0.1 and v0.2 climate comparisons (medians 0.03775 and 0.04015); this is a nonconfirmatory all-available v0.2 plant-observation extension, not fresh genetic confirmation.

eligibility.exact_sampling_geometry: original localities + five interior great circle positions along each original edge
eligibility.rule: No response-driven additions or replacement of ineligible taxa; report all 641 disposition rows, 398 potential source-complete analysis candidates, and conservative 381 taxa subset.
eligibility.insufficient_reason: Do not misclassify taxonomic mismatches or 0 returned modern observations as plant ecological absence.

climate.geography: point-based five original internal edge positions, NOT navigable 2D LGM corridors
climate.standardization: 0BP full 6343 modern geographic reference climate support mean+SD, same for LGM
climate.distance_metric: mean nearest current host or insect climate analogue at five interpolated edge positions
climate.geometry_control: log1p great-circle endpoint distance in km
result_metrics: species-level median unique host information fraction before and after geographic control
fraction of species above descriptive 0.1 of unique variance
source N range and fraction host LGM change exceeds insect

guardrails: Ecological predictor variance fractions are not variance in genotypes or genetic differentiation
Modern occurrence records do not establish native ranges or LGM occupied host habitat; original downloaded host records have establishmentMeans missing
v0.2 host observations are 3 nonrandom shallow year pages and are NOT identical to v0.1 deep-offset samples
No genetic sequence or genetic spatial response opened; NOT_EVALUABLE_EMPIRICAL_RESPONSE stays frozen
Correlated reference point draws are not independent biological replications or confidence intervals
If source SHA/identity/paired N differs, fail closed, not retune; if climate missingness occurs, report no backfill
